title: bouchea pumila
intro: Bouchea pumila, commonly known as the Dwarf Bouchea or Wild Bouchea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Lamiaceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Bouchea pumila may include wound healing, pain relief, and the reduction of fever. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
